The '''Manda Merchant Route''' was a [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] that stretched from [[Bothawui/Legends|Bothawui]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] to [[Molavar/Legends|Molavar]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It was established at some point before the [[Great Sith War/Legends|Great Sith War]] of [[4000 BBY/Legends|4000 BBY]]&ndash;[[3996 BBY]], although it only reached as far as [[Manda/Legends|Manda]] at that time. By [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], however, it had been extended to its modern terminus of Molavar.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
